notes.title: V1.2 - Update and a new level
notes.content:
New features :
- A new bonus level
- Message appears when the timer reaches 2 hours

Modifications:
- Fixed obstacle on level 5
- Increased the size of reset floor on all levels
- Fixed an infinite jump glitch

notes.title: V1.1 and price change
notes.content:
Hey players!

What is added in this patch :

Modifications:
- Level 5, you can't fall into the void anymore.
- The record section was updated.

Further note:

We decided to change the price of the game to 3.99$
If you already bought the game, you can refund it and buy it again.
If you can't, please contact us at sungamestudiosup@gmail.com
